_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. NEVER commit config.json — it holds your token. You can also leave token empty and provide it via the DCE_TOKEN environment variable.
_cliPath_comment: Path to the DiscordChatExporter CLI. On Windows point this at DiscordChatExporter.Cli.exe (built or downloaded). Ignored inside Docker (the container sets it automatically).
_outputRoot_comment: Root folder that the server folder tree is written under.
_format_comment: Json | HtmlDark | HtmlLight | PlainText | Csv. Json is recommended for backups (mergeable + browsable).
_requestDelayMs_comment: Minimum delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests to Discord. Slows the export to look less like a bot and reduce the risk of your account being flagged/banned (especially with a personal-account token). 0 disables it. 1000-2000 is a safe range; can also be set via the DCE_REQUEST_DELAY env var.
_guilds_comment: Server (guild) IDs to back up. Get them with: DiscordChatExporter.Cli guilds -t <token>
_remote_comment: Optional: after each run, push the exports to remote/cloud storage via rclone (https://rclone.org). Configure an rclone remote first.
